editorial:
Imagine failing your dream exam five times in a row. That is exactly where you find Hynek, a guy who just wants to be a doctor but ends up as a lowly hospital orderly. You can really feel his frustration as he deals with arrogant doctors who treat him like trash. The vibe is pretty dark and tense because you see him snap under the pressure. It starts with one sad request from a dying patient, but it quickly turns into something way more scary. You get to watch a normal person turn into a killer right before your eyes, and it makes you wonder how far you would go if you felt totally invisible to the world.

The acting is solid and keeps you glued to the screen, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. You will love how the tension builds up as he tries to hide his crimes. If you enjoy crime stories that focus on the mind of a villain, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, Hynek's secret finally catches up with him. The hospital staff begins to notice a strange pattern of deaths that they cannot explain. Just as he thinks he has total control over life and death, he gets caught. He does not get a happy ending or a way out. The movie wraps up by showing that his need for power was just a cover for his own failure and loneliness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological crime dramas and stories about revenge.
